definitions.explanation: A very short period of time. Emphasizes the transience or brevity of an experience, often with a poignant or wistful nuance.

examples.japanese: {束|つか}の{間|ま}の{休息|きゅうそく}だった。
examples.english: It was a brief moment of rest.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}が{止|や}んで、{束|つか}の{間|ま}の{晴|は}れ{間|ま}が{広|ひろ}がった。
examples.english: The rain stopped, and a brief clearing spread across the sky.

examples.japanese: {束|つか}の{間|ま}の{幸|しあわ}せだったが、あの{時間|じかん}は{忘|わす}れられない。
examples.english: It was a fleeting happiness, but I can never forget that time.

notes:
USAGE:
Typically used as a noun modifier with the の particle: {束|つか}の{間|ま}の + noun. Carries a literary, slightly melancholy tone — the happiness or peace described is precious precisely because it is so short. Common in written prose and narration.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {束|つか}の{間|ま}の{平和|へいわ}: a fleeting peace
- {束|つか}の{間|ま}の{幸|しあわ}せ: fleeting happiness
- {束|つか}の{間|ま}の{休息|きゅうそく}: a brief rest

ETYMOLOGY:
{束|つか} originally referred to the width of a clenched fist (about 7-8 cm), used as a unit of measurement. {束|つか}の{間|ま} literally means "the space of a fist" — metaphorically, an extremely short time.

cross_references.label: a moment, a while, a brief time
